# Scenario: domain inbound + cert-issue-type none → plain HTTP (no TLS / no redirect).
# README: domain-name with none updates .installedCert to none; nginx listens on :80.

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: domain plain HTTP none'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'setting cert mode name=e2e-http\.apinfra\.test \(absent -> none\)'
stderr 'done duration='

grep 'e2e-http\.apinfra\.test=.*\|none' $HOME/.installedCert

exists $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf
grep 'server_name e2e-http\.apinfra\.test' $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf
grep 'listen 80;' $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf
! grep 'ssl_certificate' $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf
! grep 'return 301' $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf
! grep 'listen 443' $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf

docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        domain-name: e2e-http.apinfra.test
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-web/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]

-- .env --
